entities.name: János Horváth
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: János Horváth was a Hungarian economist and politician, member of the National Assembly (MP) from 1945 to 1947, and later from 1998 to 2014. He fled to the United States after the failure of the Hungarian revolution of 1956 becoming a college professor and, later, a candidate for the United States House of Representatives.

entities.label: Person
entities.summary: János Horváth was a Hungarian economist and politician, member of the National Assembly (MP) from 1945 to 1947, and later from 1998 to 2014. He fled to the United States after the failure of the Hungarian revolution of 1956 becoming a college professor and, later, a candidate for the United States House of Representatives.
